symptom: A VERIFIED_SUCCESS for one attempt signature could be reused for a different attempt signature when fingerprint, environment, and material state matched.
lesson: The normalized learning identity includes attemptSignature. Reusable success selection must not cross method signatures merely because the semantic fingerprint and material state match.
guardrail: Require fingerprintKey, attemptSignature, environmentKey, and materialStateKey to match before returning REUSE_GUARDRAIL; otherwise continue normal failure/proceed evaluation.
